_readme: Practices and matches. Times are local to the course. Keep past items — the app filters them out.
_placeholder: Every event below is made up, to show the app working before the real schedule lands. Delete the whole 'events' array and put the real fixtures in; do not re-date these. While '_demo' is true and club.json has 'demo': true, the app shows a banner saying so.
_lineup: A match can carry a 'lineup': playing order and tee times, shown on the event. Publishing it puts student names on a public page, so it is governed by the same Phase 0 privacy decision as the results cards — leave 'lineup' out entirely and the event renders without it. Initials or first names are a middle option.
